title: Waste by-law, expense policy and advocacy plan approved
subtitle: Council also approved the CAO's 2025 objectives and received a closed-session update on employment land acquisition.
overview: Council approved a consent package of four items without any being pulled for discussion {{vote:m3}}. The most direct effect on residents is an update to the Solid Waste Management By-law, changed to align with the provincial Blue Box Regulation {{vote:m4}}.

Council also approved an updated City Council Expense Policy {{vote:m5}} and Future in Focus: Guelph's Advocacy Plan {{vote:m6}}, which sets out the city's priorities for advocating to other governments. The Chief Administrative Officer's 2025 performance objectives were approved as well {{vote:m7}}.

Before the open meeting, council met in closed session on a proposed employment land acquisition. The mayor reported that council received information and gave direction to staff. No further details were made public. Four by-laws were then approved {{vote:m8}}, and the meeting adjourned shortly after 6 p.m. Two members sent regrets.

decisions.detail: Council approved amendments to the Waste Management By-law to align with the Blue Box Regulation.
Council approved the updated City Council Expense Policy attached to report 2025-06.
Council approved Future in Focus: Guelph's Advocacy Plan.
Council approved the Chief Administrative Officer's 2025 performance objectives as set out in the attachment to report 2025-05.

debate: There was little debate. The mayor asked whether any consent items needed to be pulled for separate discussion, and none were.
No councillor raised questions on the by-laws before the vote, and no delegates are recorded in the transcript.
The closed session summary said only that council received information and gave direction to staff on the employment land acquisition.
